NATS_VERSION.description: Specific version of nats to install. Can be a numeric version or an alias.

NATS_INSTALL_METHOD.description: Installation strategy for nats: 'libscript_native' installs into isolated versioned directories and 'system' delegates to the host OS package manager.

LIBSCRIPT_LISTEN_SOCKET.description: Global unix socket to listen on

NATS_LISTEN_PORT.description: Port for NATS to listen on

NATS_LISTEN_ADDRESS.description: Address for NATS to listen on

NATS_LISTEN_SOCKET.description: Unix socket for NATS to listen on

NATS_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading nats binary or archive artifacts.

NATS_LISTEN.description: Listen endpoint (address:port or socket) for nats.

NATS_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying nats available remote releases.
